Title: A single-cell transcriptome atlas of the ageing Drosophila brain
Sex information: Male and female brains sequenced; per-cell sex NOT annotated in GEO metadata (requires roX2 inference, FBgn0019660)
Number of samples: ~56902 cells (10x); 8 age points x 2 strains (w1118, DGRP-551)
Replicates: Multiple 10x libraries per age; exact replicate structure to be verified from GEO metadata (Phase 2)
Raw-data availability: GEO processed matrices + metadata available; raw reads via SRA PRJNA420091
Potential limitations: 3' bias and per-cell sparsity limit splice-junction coverage; rMATS requires pseudo-bulking and strict junction QC; sex must be inferred per cell
Reason: Richest age series in brain tissue with both sexes; continuity with prior course work; limitations documented and mitigated by junction QC + bulk validation dataset

Title: Brain transcriptome changes in the aging Drosophila melanogaster accompany olfactory memory performance deficits
Number of samples: Small; paper notes only two 30-day-old male samples
Replicates: biological replicates; n=2 at 30d males per paper
Raw-data availability: to be verified (GEO/SRA accession from publication data-availability statement)
Potential limitations: Small replication at some age/sex points; GEO accession not yet confirmed
Reason: Bulk design is the most rMATS-compatible (full-transcript junction coverage) with both sexes and a real aging range; ideal validation set for GSE107451 splicing findings

Title: Lagging Brain Gene Expression Patterns of Drosophila melanogaster Young Adult Males Confound Comparisons Between Sexes
Potential limitations: Max age 14 days = young adult; no true aging dimension
Reason: Aging range too narrow to address brain-aging question

Title: Fly Cell Atlas: single-cell transcriptomes of the entire adult Drosophila (head)
Potential limitations: Head tissue (eyes/antennae/cuticle confound brain signal); single-nucleus 3' assay has same splicing limitations as GSE107451
Reason: Less relevant tissue than GSE107451 with no compensating advantage for the splicing question

Title: Dynamic Changes in Gene Expression Through Aging in Drosophila melanogaster Heads
Potential limitations: No female samples — sex dimension absent
